blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Я провела ___ (неделя) с палестинской семьей из Газы.
exercises.prompt: I spent a week with a Palestinian family from Gaza.
exercises.why: «The accusative case is used to denote the direct object of the preceding verb and answers the questions кого? — whom? or что? — what?» — DLI, Lesson 18.

exercises.prompt: There's no substitute.
exercises.why: «The direct object of a verb with negation (with не) is often in the genitive case instead of the accusative.» «Conversely, to say 'There isn't...', 'There aren't...', we use the word нет followed by the genitive case.» — DLI, Lesson 27; Wikibooks, «Genitive case».

exercises.why: «The person or thing feared is in the Genitive case: Я боюсь этого человека.» «The object (of ждать) is in the accusative case if animate and in the genitive case if inanimate.» — DLI, Lessons 27, 66.
